title: Cold rebuild: Detect breaking changes
summary: Rebuild Detect breaking changes from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Detect breaking changes** in *Versioning without breaking consumers*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.title: Rebuild Detect breaking changes cold
prompt: The tests declare `record Field(string Name, string Type, bool Required);`.
Write `List<string> Breaking(List<Field> before, List<Field> after, bool isRequest)`.
- `"removed {name}"` for each field in `before` missing from `after`;
- `"new required {name}"` for a field only in `after` that is required;
- `"{name} became required"` for a field optional before and required after.
(Removing a request field, or adding an optional one, is not reported.)
Report in the order of `before`, then the new fields in the order of `after`.
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
Type the shape yourself, then fill it in:
List<string> Breaking(List<Field> before, List<Field> after, bool isRequest)
